dedupe_keys.name: copernicus land monitoring service riparian zones land cover and land use along european rivers 2012 2018 and change

description: The Riparian Zones product of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service maps land cover and land use in a variable buffer along selected rivers across Europe, one of the service's priority area products. Contents: three vector layers, land cover and land use for 2012 and for 2018 and a 2012-2018 change layer, each with 55 thematic classes, a minimum mapping unit of 0.5 ha and a minimum mapping width of 10 m; the product is updated every six years. Coverage: selected European rivers, including the large navigable rivers, with their floodplains and banks. Format and access: vector data through the CLMS data viewer and dataset pages, and metadata through the CLMS catalogue API; download needs a free account. Licence and cost: free under the Copernicus data policy with attribution. Caveats: it is not a waterway asset layer, fairways and structures are not attributed, and the six-yearly updates miss recent change. Useful for vegetation and land use along inland waterways in hazard exposure and climate adaptation models, such as bank vegetation, floodplain use near locks and ports, and habitat constraints on channel works. It relates to the Urban Atlas and the high resolution tree cover layer in the catalogue.
